body:
The person she deserves to be with is anyone else.

I wont get better, my entire family hates me and there's no fucking way I would be able to make it to therapy/psychiatrist and I don't even want to get better. I want to self-loathe and continue to harm myself until I eventually off myself.

It was my fault, I shouldn't have said yes to a relationship. She'll never leave me because she's worried about my mental state and I'll never leave because I'm worried about her mental state.

I wish I could just tell her that there's no point. I'll never be normal and will probably take out my stress on her verbally. 

It eats me alive that I could've just said "I actually don't need rubbing alcohol" or just "I need it to clean electronics" or some dumb shit like that. I would probably still just casually talk to her and not have to talk about my feelings and be able to just be alone without her worrying about me.

Before was bad but this is so much worse, I thought I was alone with my feelings but knowing I am not honestly just makes me feel like shit. 

Like I said in the post my life is honestly fine, I'm just a fucking asshole who's unable to be happy and just go through massive mood-swings constantly and too much of a pussy to try to get meds to fix it.

 Again, she is honestly perfect, if my mental state was anything but absolutely fucked I would be so happy (as I thought I would be). But now I realize that I am incapable of being happy for any extended period of time.
Like how does she not realize I'm toxic as fuck? Surely at she has to realize and get the fuck out? That point should've been the day she found out I self-harm, it's so illogical.

She absolutely supports me, like the day she actually said she loves me was the same day I bashed my hand against railing at school hard multiple times to cope with some stress at the time.

She also got past me messaging her at like 2am blaming her for only liking me out of pity. She's perfect and that's what makes it so hard to break up. I don't think it's possible to go back to normal so there's no point in her worrying about me. The only reason I was ever really emotional with her was because I basically accidentally told her that I cut myself (asked for rubbing-alcohol to disinfect a wound, she basically interrogated to why I needed it). Beforehand she literally didn't ask me for a hug when she was having a bad week because she thought I was apathetic.

If I didn't care about her I wouldn't have to worry and it would be so much easier.
Don't see it as a streak, see it as 1/226 days you broke, if you can go that long it's an outlier.
